import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/app/data/sensor_readings.csv', parse_dates=['timestamp'])
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['timestamp', 'sensor_id'], keep='first')

cairo = df['timestamp'].dt.tz_localize('Africa/Cairo', nonexistent='shift_forward', ambiguous='NaT')
df = df.assign(ts_utc=cairo.dt.tz_convert('UTC'))
df = df.dropna(subset=['ts_utc'])
df['hour_start'] = df['ts_utc'].dt.floor('h')

agg = df.groupby(['sensor_id', 'hour_start'])['temperature'].agg(
    mean_temp='mean', min_temp='min', max_temp='max').reset_index()
agg = agg.sort_values(['sensor_id', 'hour_start'])
agg['mean_temp'] = agg['mean_temp'].round(2)
agg['hour_start'] = agg['hour_start'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z')
agg['hour_start'] = agg['hour_start'].str[:-2] + ':' + agg['hour_start'].str[-2:]
agg = agg[['sensor_id', 'hour_start', 'mean_temp', 'min_temp', 'max_temp']]
agg.to_csv('/app/output/hourly_aggregates.csv', index=False)
print(agg.head(10))
print(len(agg))
EOF
